response.original_title: ぼくはうみがみたくなりました
response.overview: Through a twist of fate, nursing student Asumi and Junichi end up going together on a sentimental journey to the sea. Soon, she notices something odd about the way he walks and talks, eventually coming to the realization that the young man is autistic. Asumi’s trip will change her outlook on life in the most unexpected ways.
response.title: ぼくはうみがみたくなりました
